pretreatments.description: Alkaline treatment using different alkali agents (NaOH, KOH, Ca(OH)2) to reach pH values of 8, 9, 10 and 11.
Mechanical dispersion using a high-speed shearing device (IKA T25 Ultra Turrax Digital disperser) with rotation speeds ranging from 4000 to 24,000 rpm for treatment times between 15 and 180 minutes.
